<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  id="Definitions_OrderToCash"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/order-to-cash"
                  exporter="Mastra Code" exporterVersion="1.0">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderReceived" name="New customer order" />
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received" />
  <bpmn:process id="Process_OrderToCash" name="Order-to-Cash" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:documentation>Assumption-based model created without a user-provided workflow definition. Assumes a generic B2B seller: order intake triggers inventory and credit checks; out-of-stock orders loop on a backorder; failed credit checks end in rejection; fulfilled orders are picked, packed, shipped, invoiced; payment is awaited with a 30-day overdue reminder and a partial-payment dispute loop; finally payment is reconciled and the order archived. isExecutable=false: system/user implementations, SLAs and org-specific rules are placeholders.</bpmn:documentation>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderReceived" name="Order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition messageRef="Message_OrderReceived" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_RecordOrder" name="Record sales order" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckInventory" name="Check inventory availability" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InventoryAvailable" name="Inventory available?" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreateBackorder" name="Create backorder and confirm lead time" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CreditCheck" name="Perform credit check" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CreditApproved" name="Credit approved?" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_NotifyRejection" name="Notify customer of rejection" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Rejected" name="Order rejected" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ConfirmOrder" name="Confirm order with customer" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PickItems" name="Pick items" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PackOrder" name="Pack order" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShipOrder" name="Ship order" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_GenerateInvoice" name="Generate invoice" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendInvoice" name="Send invoice to customer" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitPayment" name="Wait for payment" messageRef="Message_PaymentReceived" />
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_PaymentOverdue" name="Payment overdue (30 days)" attachedToRef="Task_WaitPayment">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
        <bpmn:timeDuration>P30D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendReminder" name="Send payment reminder" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_PaymentInFull" name="Payment in full?" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ResolveDiscrepancy" name="Resolve payment discrepancy" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ReconcilePayment" name="Reconcile payment in ledger" />
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ArchiveOrder" name="Archive order record" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Fulfilled" name="Order fulfilled" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Record" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderReceived" targetRef="Task_RecordOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_CheckInventory" sourceRef="Task_RecordOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckInventory" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckInventory_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckInventory" targetRef="Gateway_InventoryAvailable" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_Backorder" name="Out of stock" sourceRef="Gateway_InventoryAvailable" targetRef="Task_CreateBackorder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Backorder_Loop" sourceRef="Task_CreateBackorder" targetRef="Task_CheckInventory" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inventory_CreditCheck" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_InventoryAvailable" targetRef="Task_CreditCheck" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CreditCheck_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CreditCheck" targetRef="Gateway_CreditApproved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Credit_Reject" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_CreditApproved" targetRef="Task_NotifyRejection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reject_End" sourceRef="Task_NotifyRejection" targetRef="EndEvent_Rejected" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Credit_Confirm" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_CreditApproved" targetRef="Task_ConfirmOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Confirm_Pick" sourceRef="Task_ConfirmOrder" targetRef="Task_PickItems" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pick_Pack" sourceRef="Task_PickItems" targetRef="Task_PackOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Pack_Ship" sourceRef="Task_PackOrder" targetRef="Task_ShipOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ship_Invoice" sourceRef="Task_ShipOrder" targetRef="Task_GenerateInvoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invoice_Send" sourceRef="Task_GenerateInvoice" targetRef="Task_SendInvoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Send_WaitPayment" sourceRef="Task_SendInvoice" targetRef="Task_WaitPayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WaitPayment_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_WaitPayment" targetRef="Gateway_PaymentInFull" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Discrepancy" name="No / partial" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentInFull" targetRef="Task_ResolveDiscrepancy" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Discrepancy_Loop" sourceRef="Task_ResolveDiscrepancy" targetRef="Task_WaitPayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Reconcile" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_PaymentInFull" targetRef="Task_ReconcilePayment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reconcile_Archive" sourceRef="Task_ReconcilePayment" targetRef="Task_ArchiveOrder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Archive_End" sourceRef="Task_ArchiveOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_Fulfilled" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Overdue_Reminder" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_PaymentOverdue" targetRef="Task_SendReminder" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_Loop" sourceRef="Task_SendReminder" targetRef="Task_WaitPayment" />
  </bpmn:process>
